posts.title: Let's Go Bowling Baby! After Falling Short By Inches, The Gators Made A Mile-Long Quantum Leap
posts.excerpt: It was the legs of No. 12, Aaron Philo, which carried the Gators to victory. Florida 21, No. 11 Kentucky 14. Six wins. Bowl eligible. And the quarterback did it with his legs…
